title: AutoRefine: Auto-Calibrating Code Judges from Workflow Outcomes
abstract: arXiv:2611.09291v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM judges increasingly serve as quality gates for code changes that have no test oracle, but a judge prompt must be calibrated for its task and recalibrated as the system it judges evolves, while hand labels for the calibration are resource intensive and go stale. Development workflows emit outcome labels for free (tests pass or fail, changes land or are abandoned), but these labels are noisy. We present AutoRefine, a loop that rewrites a deployable judge's prompt to reproduce outcome labels, with an informed teacher that sees the judge's input plus the outcome, explains each label it keeps, and abstains when the outcome cannot be explained from what the judge sees. On a held-out dataset with an execution oracle, calibration raised chance-corrected agreement (Scott's $\pi$) from 0.36 to 0.60. translated_title: AutoRefine：基于工作流结果的代码评审器自动校准
translated_abstract: LLM评审器日益成为无测试基准的代码变更的质量把关者，但评审器提示词必须针对其任务进行校准，并随着被评审系统的演进而重新校准，而用于校准的人工标注既耗费资源又会过时。开发工作流可以免费产生结果标签（测试通过或失败、变更合入或被放弃），但这些标签是有噪声的。我们提出了AutoRefine，这是一个循环过程，通过重写可部署评审器的提示词来复现结果标签，其中包含一个知情的教师模型：它可以看到评审器的输入以及结果，为其保留的每个标签提供解释，并在无法根据评审器所见内容解释结果时选择弃权。在一个带有执行基准的保留数据集上，校准将经机会校正的一致性（Scott's π）从0.36提升到0.60。在一个已部署智能体的结果标签上，随机翻转25%的标签以引入噪声时，教师模型将翻转的FAIL标签搁置（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: AutoRefine利用开发工作流免费产生的结果标签（如测试通过/失败、变更合入/放弃）来自动校准LLM代码评审器的提示词，并通过一个能解释标签或选择弃权的教师模型过滤噪声，将评审器与执行基准的机会校正一致性从0.36提升到0.60。
en_tdlr: AutoRefine automatically calibrates an LLM code judge's prompt using free outcome labels from development workflows (tests passing/failing, changes landing/abandoned), with an informed teacher that explains labels or abstains to filter noise, raising chance-corrected agreement with an execution oracle from 0.36 to 0.60.
